annotations.title: What the Modkeel lab saw a mod do

description: Everything the Modkeel lab saw one Minecraft mod do: each Minecraft version where it ran on a server or a client, or crashed, and every mod it ran with or clashed with. Use it for "does this mod work on 1.21.1?", "which versions was it tested on?" or to check a suspect from diagnose_crash. For one specific pair of mods, check_mod_pair gives a direct verdict; for what the mod is and where to get it, get_mod_info. Takes a mod id; from a name, call search_mods first. A mod the lab never ran returns tested: false with empty lists, not an error. Returns every matching row, unpaginated: a few dozen at most per mod.

mc.description: Minecraft version to narrow the answer to, e.g. 1.21.1, 1.20.1 or 26.2. Omit it to get every version the lab ran; with it, only runs on exactly that version count.

mod_id.description: Lowercase mod id as the loader knows it (the Modrinth/Fabric/NeoForge id, e.g. sodium, create, entityculling), not the display name. Unsure of the id? Call search_mods first.

name: get_mod_runs
